message.reasoning_content: Verify independently: check sum arithmetic, uniq count, and that words are sorted case-sensitively.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd "$(pwd)"
echo "--- verify sum ---"; awk '{s+=$1} END{printf "sum=%d\n", s}' data/a.txt
python3 -c "
vals=[int(x) for x in open('data/a.txt').read().split()]
print('python sum:', sum(vals))
ws=open('data/b.txt').read().split()
u=sorted(set(ws))
print('python unique sorted:', u, 'count', len(u))
print('sum.txt matches:', open('out/sum.txt').read().strip()==str(sum(vals)))
print('words.txt matches:', open('out/words.txt').read().split()==u)
"
echo "--- check words.txt already sorted+unique ---"
LC_ALL=C sort -c -u out/words.txt && echo "ok: sorted and unique"
ls -la out"}
